en: A colorized historic postcard view of a large hilltop castle complex overlooking a small town. The castle has tall light-colored walls with narrow windows and steep red gabled roofs, plus towers and a church-like building with a spire. Below the castle are clustered townhouses and trees. The caption at the top left reads "Schloss Nossen." Vertical text at the right margin indicates the publisher, and there are some smaller printer or artist credits along the left side.
